title.en: EA pages show results month by month
title.zh: EA 页面可以按月看结果了

details.en: For each market with a reliable backtest, EA pages now show the share of months with a gain and the best and worst month, with dates. EA backtests are also re-run every month on the latest twelve months of hourly data.
details.zh: EA 页面上，每个有可信回测的品种都会显示盈利月份的占比，以及最好和最差的月份（附月份）。EA 回测也改为每月用最近 12 个月的小时线重跑一次。

title.en: Strategy results now always use walk-forward optimization
title.zh: 策略结果一律改用滚动前推优化

details.en: Until now, each strategy kept its default parameters whenever they scored better over the whole history than the walk-forward run. That choice looked at the full sample, so it flattered the results: it applied to 106 of 576 strategy-and-market results, which scored a median of 5.6 points higher than their walk-forward versions. Every result now uses walk-forward optimization, so some numbers and rankings moved down.
details.zh: 之前，如果默认参数在整段历史上比滚动前推得分更高，策略就保留默认参数。这一步看过了整段样本，会把结果美化：576 个“策略 × 市场”结果里有 106 个属于这种情况，得分中位数比滚动前推版本高 5.6 分。现在所有结果一律采用滚动前推优化，部分数字和排名因此有所下降。

title.en: Identical EA backtests are no longer counted
title.zh: 结果完全相同的 EA 回测不再计入

details.en: 85 EAs produced exactly the same backtest as another EA on every market — for example 14 unrelated EAs with identical results — which means the automatic conversion lost what made them different. Their 298 results are now labeled "Same as other EAs", with links to the twins, and are left out of the EA Ranking, the category statistics and the blow-up risk evidence. Reliable EA results go from 1,421 to 1,123. The article on 1,063 free MT5 EAs and the glossary have been updated.
details.zh: 有 85 个 EA 的回测在每个市场上都和另一个 EA 一模一样——比如有 14 个毫不相干的 EA 结果完全相同——说明自动转换丢掉了它们各自的特点。这 298 个结果现在标为“与其他 EA 结果相同”，并链接到结果相同的 EA，不再参与 EA 排行榜、分类统计和爆仓风险判断。可信的 EA 结果从 1,421 个变为 1,123 个。关于 1,063 个免费 MT5 EA 的文章和指标词典已同步更新。

title.en: EA pages compare each EA with its category
title.zh: EA 页面会和同类 EA 做对比

details.en: Under the backtest table, EA pages now show how each result ranks against other EAs of the same category on the same market, for example "EURUSD: better than 82% of 37". Only reliable results count, and only when at least ten EAs of the category have one.
details.zh: EA 页面的回测表下方新增一行：每个品种上，这个 EA 的结果在同类 EA 里排在什么位置，例如“EURUSD 好于 82%（共 37 个）”。只统计可信结果，而且同类里至少要有 10 个 EA 有结果才显示。

title.en: Two new glossary terms: recovery factor and blow-up risk
title.zh: 指标词典新增：恢复因子、爆仓风险

details.en: The glossary now has 20 terms. Recovery factor explains the number in the EA Ranking (the median EA backtest scored about zero). Blow-up risk explains broker stop-outs, how our backtests handle them and how the EA labels work: 61 of 307 gold backtests with default lot sizes ended in a stop-out, none on three currency pairs. EA pages link to both.
details.zh: 指标词典现在有 20 个词条。“恢复因子”解释 EA 排行榜里的这个数（EA 回测的中位数大约是 0）。“爆仓风险”讲券商强平、我们的回测怎么处理，以及 EA 标签怎么来的：用默认手数交易黄金的 307 条回测里有 61 条爆仓，三个外汇品种上一条都没有。EA 页面都链接到了这两个词条。

title.en: Blow-up risk label for every Expert Advisor
title.zh: 每个 EA 都有了爆仓风险标签

details.en: Each EA now carries a blow-up risk label built from its code and our backtests: martingale sizing, grid orders, no stop loss, several positions at once, and whether the account was stopped out in our backtest. The label shows on EA pages, in the EA Arena (with a filter), in the EA Ranking and on the category pages. 93 EAs are rated high, 66 elevated. EA categories in the app now match the EA pages.
details.zh: 每个 EA 都根据代码和我们的回测打上了爆仓风险标签，依据包括：马丁加仓、网格挂单、没有止损、同时持有多个仓位，以及回测中是否爆仓。标签显示在 EA 页面、EA 竞技场（可筛选）、EA 排行榜和分类页上。目前 93 个 EA 为高风险，66 个偏高。应用里的 EA 分类也和 EA 页面统一了。

title.en: A plain leaderboard page and a faster home page
title.zh: 新增排行榜静态页，首页打开更快

details.en: The new leaderboard page lists the top 10 strategies on every market for the last 12 months and the last five years, in English and Chinese, without waiting for the app to load. The home page now shows its summary, top strategies and latest research straight away, and every static page links to the static versions of the leaderboard, strategy library, EA categories and info pages.
details.zh: 新的排行榜页面列出每个市场近 12 个月和近 5 年的前 10 名策略，中英文都有，不用等应用加载。首页打开就能看到概览、排名前列的策略和最新研究；所有静态页的导航也直接链接到排行榜、策略库、EA 分类和说明页的静态版本。

title.en: Readable pages for About, Methodology, FAQ and more
title.zh: 关于、方法论、FAQ 等页面有了可直接阅读的版本

details.en: About, Methodology, FAQ, Changelog, Privacy and Terms now have plain HTML versions (English and Chinese) that load without JavaScript and are what search engines index. Tool views such as the EA ranking and the strategy lab are no longer offered to search engines.
details.zh: 关于、方法论、常见问题、更新日志、隐私政策和使用条款都有了中英文的纯 HTML 版本，不用等脚本加载就能看，搜索引擎收录的也是这些页面。EA 排行、策略实验室这类工具页不再提交给搜索引擎。

title.en: Eight new research articles
title.zh: 新增 8 篇研究文章

details.en: New data-driven articles on luck-adjusted Sharpe ratios across 72 strategies, which strategies held up in 2022, 1,063 free MT5 EAs backtested, why martingale and grid EAs blow up, moving averages on bitcoin, turtle trading since 2021, MACD with an RSI filter, and how to read drawdown, the Ulcer index and rolling Sharpe. The Keltner vs Bollinger article was rewritten with ten-market results.
details.zh: 新增几篇用站内数据写的文章：72 个策略扣除运气后的夏普、哪些策略扛过了 2022 年、1063 个免费 MT5 EA 回测、马丁和网格 EA 为什么会爆仓、均线策略在比特币上的表现、2021 年以来的海龟交易法、MACD 加 RSI 过滤，以及怎么看回撤、Ulcer 指数和滚动夏普。肯特纳 vs 布林带一文也用 10 个市场的结果重写了。

title.en: Browse Expert Advisors by category
title.zh: 可以按类别浏览 EA 了

details.en: Each EA category — trend following, grid, martingale, scalping and more — now has its own page with a short explanation, backtest statistics for the whole group, how many EAs are rated dangerous, and every EA sorted by how many markets it made money on.
details.zh: 趋势跟踪、网格、马丁格尔、剥头皮等每个 EA 类别都有了单独页面：简短说明、整组的回测统计、被评为危险的数量，以及按盈利品种数排序的全部 EA。

title.en: EA backtests rerun with realistic position sizes
title.zh: EA 回测按真实仓位全部重跑

details.en: The converted EAs kept adding orders while one was still pending and treated lots as units, so positions grew far beyond the EA's lot size and most P&L figures were wrong. All 1,063 EAs were rerun on four markets with MT5 lot sizes, 1:100 leverage, one order at a time and a broker-style stop-out. Three conversion bugs that kept some EAs from ever trading were fixed. The EA Ranking now also shows the recovery factor and on how many markets each EA made money. Results that rely on a placeholder for a custom indicator are now labeled as approximations and left out of the ranking, and EA pages explain why an EA never traded when the cause is a conversion bug.
details.zh: 自动转换的 EA 会在挂单未成交时继续下单，而且把手数当成单位，仓位远远超出 EA 设定的手数，大部分盈亏数字都不对。1063 个 EA 已在四个品种上全部重跑：按 MT5 手数计仓、1:100 杠杆、同一时间只有一张挂单，并像券商一样强制平仓。同时修了三类让部分 EA 永远不触发交易的转换错误。EA 排行榜新增恢复因子，以及每个 EA 在几个品种上盈利。依赖占位指标代替自定义指标的结果现在标为“近似”，不参与排名；如果 EA 从不交易是转换错误造成的，EA 页面会写明原因。

title.en: Confidence ranges for every strategy
title.zh: 每个策略都有了置信区间

details.en: Strategy pages show a 90% bootstrap range for CAGR and maximum drawdown, plus the chance of a loss, so you can see how much a result depends on a few lucky stretches. A new glossary entry explains how it is computed.
details.zh: 策略页新增年化收益和最大回撤的 90% Bootstrap 区间，以及亏损概率，可以看出一个结果有多依赖少数几段运气。指标词典新增词条，说明计算方法。

title.en: Clearer EA backtest status and a trading-cost slider
title.zh: EA 回测状态更清楚，新增交易成本滑块

details.en: EA backtests now say why a result is missing: the EA could not be converted automatically (most cases), it held one position to the end, or it really never traded. Strategy pages have a slider that shows the annual return after 0–50 bp of trading costs.
details.zh: EA 回测现在会说明结果缺失的原因：无法自动转换（大多数情况）、只开了一笔仓位一直持有到结束，还是确实从未交易。策略页新增滑块，可以看扣除 0–50 个基点交易成本后的年化收益。

title.en: Shareable portfolios and quick links to new tools
title.zh: 组合可以分享了，首页新增新功能入口

details.en: Portfolio weights in the compare view now live in the link, so a mix of strategies can be bookmarked or shared with one click. The home page links straight to the Strategy Lab, today's signals, the heatmap, weekly reports and the glossary.
details.zh: 对比页里的组合权重现在会保存在链接里，一键就能收藏或分享一组策略组合。首页新增入口，可以直达策略实验室、今日信号、热力图、每周报告和指标词典。

title.en: Strategy Lab: compare your own backtest
title.zh: 策略实验室：把你自己的回测拿来比一比

details.en: Upload an equity curve (CSV) or a MetaTrader strategy tester report and see where it ranks against every arena strategy on the same market and the same trading days. Everything is computed in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
details.zh: 上传权益曲线（CSV）或 MetaTrader 策略测试报告，看看它在同一市场、同样的交易日里，和竞技场每个策略相比排在哪里。所有计算都在你的浏览器里完成，文件不会上传。

title.en: Crisis tests, luck-adjusted Sharpe and embeddable badges
title.zh: 大跌测试、扣除运气的夏普与可嵌入徽章

details.en: Strategy pages now show how each strategy did in the Q4 2018 sell-off, the COVID crash and the 2022 bear market, its returns above and below the 200-day average, CAGR after 10 bp trading costs, and the Deflated Sharpe Ratio, which corrects for testing many strategies at once. Each strategy also has a live Arena Score badge you can embed.
details.zh: 策略页新增：在 2018 年四季度下跌、新冠暴跌和 2022 年熊市中的表现，市场在 200 日均线上方和下方时的收益，扣除 10 bp 交易成本后的年化收益，以及修正“同时测试很多策略”偏差的 Deflated 夏普。每个策略还有可以嵌入的实时 Arena Score 徽章。

title.en: Chinese strategy pages and share images
title.zh: 中文策略页与分享图

details.en: All 72 strategy pages and the category pages now have Chinese versions, and every strategy has a share image with its equity curve and key numbers for social media previews.
details.zh: 72 个策略页和分类页都有了中文版；每个策略还配了分享图，带权益曲线和关键数字，分享到社交平台时会显示预览卡片。

title.en: Today's signals, strategy heatmap, weekly reports and RSS
title.zh: 今日信号、策略热力图、每周报告与 RSS

details.en: New pages show the current position of every strategy on every market, an Arena Score heatmap of strategies × markets, and an automatic weekly report (market moves, signal changes, best and worst strategies). Follow along with the RSS feed at /feed.xml (Chinese: /zh/feed.xml).
details.zh: 新增页面：每个策略在每个市场的当前持仓、策略 × 市场的 Arena Score 热力图，以及自动生成的每周报告（市场涨跌、信号变化、表现最好和最差的策略）。可以通过 RSS 订阅：/feed.xml（中文版 /zh/feed.xml）。

title.en: Arena Score v2 and 20 new metrics
title.zh: Arena Score 第二版与 20 项新指标

details.en: The Arena Score now ranks each strategy against the others on the same market and window across five components (return quality, drawdown control, consistency, robustness, significance), so the leaderboard no longer has blocks of ties at 100 or 0, and strategies that were almost never in the market are not ranked. Strategy pages add time in market, Ulcer index, longest drawdown, VaR/CVaR, alpha, beta, capture ratios and the probabilistic Sharpe ratio, with five new glossary entries.
details.zh: Arena Score 改为在同一品种、同一窗口内，按五个分项（收益质量、回撤控制、稳定性、稳健性、统计可信度）和其他策略比较打分，排行榜不再出现大片 100 分或 0 分的并列，几乎不持仓的策略也不再参与排名。策略页新增持仓时间、Ulcer 指数、最长回撤、VaR/CVaR、Alpha、Beta、捕获率和概率夏普等指标，词典也新增了 5 个词条。

title.en: Every strategy, article and EA now has its own page
title.zh: 每个策略、文章和 EA 都有了独立页面

details.en: 72 strategy pages with equity curves, results on every market and a buy-and-hold comparison; strategy category hubs; research articles in English and Chinese; a 12-term metrics glossary with live examples; and 1,515 EA pages in both languages. Pages load fast and can be found by search engines.
details.zh: 72 个策略页（含权益曲线、各市场结果、与买入持有的对比）、策略分类页、中英文研究文章、12 个指标词条（附排行榜真实例子），以及 1515 个中英文 EA 页面。页面加载快，也更容易被搜索引擎找到。

title.en: EA rankings now only use reliable backtests
title.zh: EA 排行榜只统计有效回测

details.en: Sharpe ratios are recomputed from each equity curve (the old values used yearly returns and were often meaningless). Results with no trades, run errors or flat curves are labelled and left out of the ranking, and detail pages say why.
details.zh: 夏普比率改为按每条权益曲线重新计算（旧数值按年度收益计算，很多没有意义）。零交易、运行报错或曲线持平的结果会被标注并排除在排名之外，详情页也会说明原因。

title.en: Site-wide search and recently viewed
title.zh: 全站搜索与最近浏览

details.en: Press / or Ctrl/Cmd+K anywhere to search strategies, EAs, research notes and pages. The home page now remembers what you opened recently (stored only in your browser).
details.zh: 在任意页面按 / 或 Ctrl/Cmd+K，就能搜索策略、EA、研究文章和页面。首页会记住你最近看过的内容（只保存在你自己的浏览器里）。

title.en: Redesigned header, home page and footer
title.zh: 导航、首页和页脚全新改版

details.en: A cleaner navigation with a More menu, icon theme and language toggles, a new home overview with live counts, quick-entry cards, ranked top strategies, a timeline changelog, back-to-top button and a reading progress bar on articles.
details.zh: 导航更简洁，次要页面收进“更多”菜单，主题和语言切换改成图标按钮。首页新增平台概览、快捷入口和带分数的策略排行；更新日志改成时间线；文章页加了阅读进度条，长页面有回到顶部按钮。

title.en: Faster loading and real backtest data restored
title.zh: 加载提速，恢复真实回测数据

details.en: Equity curves are now split per instrument and loaded on demand, and EA analysis data only loads on EA pages, cutting the initial download from tens of MB to about 3 MB. The last complete backtest snapshot (2026-08-17) is back in place of placeholder figures, and pages show the data date clearly.
details.zh: 净值曲线按品种拆分、按需加载，EA 分析数据只在 EA 页面才下载，首次打开的数据量从几十 MB 降到 3MB 左右。同时恢复了最近一次完整的回测数据（2026-08-17），不再显示占位数字，页面上也会标明数据日期。

entries.title: Backtest Pipeline Complete: 560 Strategies Tested
entries.details: All 560 auto-convertible EA strategies have been backtested on EURUSD H1 data (730 days) using backtrader. Results include total trades, win rate, P&L, max drawdown, and equity curves for each EA.

entries.title: Equity Curve Visualization
entries.details: EA detail pages now display an equity curve chart rendered with Canvas API. Charts show ~200 downsampled points with gradient fill and theme-aware styling.

entries.title: Markdown Rendering for EA Analysis
entries.details: EA analysis and description fields now render Markdown syntax (headings, lists, code blocks, bold/italic) using marked.js v15.0.12. Both Chinese and English views support full Markdown.

entries.title: Backtest Result Auto-Sync
entries.details: Added sync_backtest_to_site.py to automate the full cycle: generate strategy → run backtest → update index → publish site → push to repo.

entries.title: Generator Overhaul: Sub-Line + Level Reference Resolution
entries.details: MQ5→Python generator now resolves Bollinger Band sub-lines (.lines.bot/.top/.mid), Ichimoku sub-lines (.l.tenkan/.l.kijun/.l.senkou_span_a/.l.senkou_span_b), and 30+ level reference patterns (oversold, overbought, ADX threshold, etc.). Same-base crossover guard prevents CrossOver(close, close) false signals.

entries.title: EA Comparison Feature
entries.details: EA Arena now supports side-by-side comparison of up to 4 EAs. Select via checkboxes, compare metrics in a modal overlay, and share comparisons via URL parameters.

entries.title: MQ5→Python Backtest Pipeline
entries.details: Implemented Scheme 2 pipeline: LLM-assisted MQ5→structured JSON→Python backtrader template. Includes extract_logic.py (GLM-5.1 analysis), generate_backtrader.py (template codegen), and run_backtest.py (execution with progress tracking).

entries.title: EA Arena: 1515 EAs Analyzed
entries.details: Completed analysis of 1515 MQL5 Expert Advisors with bilingual CN/EN descriptions, parameter documentation, and category classification. All EAs separated into utility and trading categories.

entries.title: Bilingual EA Detail Pages
entries.details: Each EA now has a standalone HTML detail page with full Chinese/English toggle, markdown-rendered analysis, parameter tables, and strategy classification.

entries.title: Performance Optimization: Lazy-Load EA Data
entries.details: Reduced initial page load from 12MB to 17KB by splitting EA catalog into a lightweight index and per-EA lazy-loaded JSON files.

entries.title: SEO: 1,510+ URLs in Sitemap
entries.details: Expanded sitemap from 15 to 1,510+ URLs covering all EA detail pages. Added OG and Twitter Card meta tags with canonical URLs.

entries.title: Cleaned Monthly Resample Warnings
entries.details: Updated monthly resample frequency to ME in strategy scripts to avoid pandas deprecation warnings.

entries.title: Added Parameter Sensitivity Heatmaps
entries.details: Strategy detail pages now visualize parameter grid sensitivity using Arena Score heatmaps.

entries.title: Added Latest Snapshot Panel
entries.details: Strategy detail headers now show the most recent data point and daily benchmark/strategy move.

entries.title: Added Performance Attribution
entries.details: Strategy detail pages now include alpha/beta attribution with contribution curves and summary metrics.

entries.title: Added Auto Publish Script
entries.details: Added a PowerShell script to build data, publish the site, and push the public repo for scheduled automation.

entries.title: Isolated AdSense on Content Routes
entries.details: Tool routes now force a clean reload when ad scripts are present, preventing ads from appearing on low-content screens.

entries.title: Added Donchian/Turtle Breakout Research
entries.details: Published a long-form deep dive into Donchian channel breakouts and the Turtle rulebook.

entries.title: Added Supertrend and ATR Research
entries.details: Published a long-form note on supertrend signals and ATR trailing stop risk control.

entries.title: Added Ichimoku Cloud Research
entries.details: Published a long-form guide to Ichimoku cloud signals and regime filters.

entries.title: Added RSI Mean Reversion Research
entries.details: Published a long-form RSI mean reversion strategy analysis to reach five research articles.

entries.title: Added Sitemap and Robots
entries.details: Created sitemap.xml and robots.txt to help search crawlers discover content pages.

entries.title: Scoped AdSense to Content Pages
entries.details: AdSense now loads only on research and policy content, with canonical metadata updates to reduce duplicate URLs.

entries.title: Added Research Articles
entries.details: Published long-form analyses for EMA Crossover, Parabolic SAR, Volatility Breakout, and the Arena scoring methodology.

entries.title: Added Research Hub and Homepage Entry Points
entries.details: Research index, featured article highlights, and new Learn the Method section on the homepage.

entries.title: Added Policy and FAQ Pages
entries.details: Expanded About/Methodology plus Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, and FAQ pages.

entries.title: Added 1 Mean Reversion Strategy
entries.details: Ultimate Oscillator added. Total strategies now 70.

entries.title: Added MR-15 Ultimate Oscillator
entries.details: Ultimate Oscillator mean reversion using multi-horizon buying pressure.

entries.title: Added 1 Mean Reversion Strategy
entries.details: Detrended Price Oscillator added. Total strategies now 69.

entries.title: Added MR-14 Detrended Price Oscillator
entries.details: DPO mean reversion using a detrended price oscillator.

entries.title: Added 1 Mean Reversion Strategy
entries.details: TRIX Reversion added. Total strategies now 68.

entries.title: Added MR-13 TRIX Reversion
entries.details: Triple-smoothed EMA momentum extremes for mean reversion entries.

entries.title: Added 3 Trend Strategies
entries.details: Coppock Curve, Elder Triple Screen, Vortex Indicator. Total strategies now 67.

entries.title: Added TREND-18 Coppock Curve
entries.details: Weighted momentum curve for long-term trend timing.

entries.title: Added TREND-19 Elder Triple Screen
entries.details: Multi-filter trend system combining MACD, pullbacks, and breakouts.

entries.title: Added TREND-20 Vortex Indicator
entries.details: Vortex indicator crossovers for trend entries and exits.

entries.title: Added 3 Trend Strategies
entries.details: Triple Moving Average, Linear Regression Channel, Darvas Box. Total strategies now 64.

entries.title: Added TREND-13 Triple Moving Average
entries.details: Three moving averages confirm trend direction before entries.

entries.title: Added TREND-14 Linear Regression Channel
entries.details: Regression channel breakout with mean-reversion exits.

entries.title: Added TREND-15 Darvas Box
entries.details: Box breakout strategy using rolling highs/lows.

entries.title: Added Risk Contribution Analysis
entries.details: Portfolio Builder now breaks down marginal and percentage risk contribution per strategy.

entries.title: Added 5 Advanced Strategies
entries.details: Volatility Regime Strategy, Momentum Crash Protection, Cointegration Basket, Flight to Quality, MACD+RSI Filter. Total strategies now 61.

entries.title: Added VOL-13 Volatility Regime Strategy
entries.details: Switches between trend following (low vol) and mean reversion (high vol) based on volatility regime.

entries.title: Added MOM-11 Momentum Crash Protection
entries.details: Momentum strategy with drawdown-based position scaling to protect against momentum crashes.

entries.title: Added STAT-11 Cointegration Basket
entries.details: Multi-asset spread trading using rolling regression weights for mean reversion.
